run_hydra_config_test: run the test_hydra_configs function to register habitat plugin and execute a training experiment
compose_hydra_config: compose a Hydra config with habitat baselines RL overrides using my_app_compose_api
register_hydra_plugin: register the HabitatConfigPlugin so task configs can be used with Hydra compose
execute_experiment: execute a habitat baselines training experiment with execute_exp using a composed config
print_config_yaml: print the composed Hydra config as YAML using OmegaConf.to_yaml for inspection
